post.description: Multipart upload, streamed to raw/. The clip is UPLOADING while the bytes arrive, then PROBING.
The video links in a document (docx, xlsx, pptx, odt) or a text file. Nothing is imported.
One DOWNLOADING clip per video that isn't in the library yet.

delete.description: Only READY/FAILED clips with no renders (delete the renders first). Files go too.

post.description: FAILED -> PROBING again if the bytes are here, else DOWNLOADING again (url clips).
A PNG with transparency. Stored under a new name each time, so browsers never show a stale logo.

get.description: unscheduled: renders with no post other than CANCELLED ones, and not superseded by a re-render.

delete.description:
Not while RENDERING, and not while a live (non-CANCELLED) post refers to it. Its CANCELLED posts
and files go too. FOR UPDATE: a cover change in flight lands first, so its file is the one deleted.

put.description:
The Reel cover (Zernio instagramThumbnail): a JPEG, ideally 1080x1920 (the Editor sends exactly that).
Stored under a new name each time, so browsers never show a stale cover. 409 once the render has posts.

delete.description: Back to Instagram's own pick. 409 once the render has posts.

post.description: Pull GET /v1/accounts from Zernio (read-only) and upsert Instagram accounts by zernio_account_id.

get.description: Sorted by scheduled_for. from/to filter on coalesce(published_at, scheduled_for).
